featured_reviews.name: Bhavika Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I strongly request everyone not to visit this place.

We ordered a fruit bowl costing around ₹300 for our 10-month-old baby, assuming that under a brand name, the quality would be good and premium. Unfortunately, this assumption turned out to be completely false.

I clearly requested their staff not to add any tangy fruits, yet they still added orange, which was extremely sour—so much so that even adults could not eat it.

The rest of the fruits, including apple and papaya, were in very poor condition and not fresh at all.

Overall, the fruit quality was extremely low—worse than what is usually offered by street vendors. This was a very disappointing and unacceptable experience, especially when it involved food for an infant.

featured_reviews.name: Andy B
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at top level of Oberio Mall sandwiched between Burger King & Taco Bell, it is a small outlets but commands it's own patron.

The selling point is health. But don't be surprised if you don't get your desired drink. This is what happened to us. We wanted avocado juice, but to our dismay there weren't any. Neither were there any notification that specific drinks are not available.

We settled for grapes and berry juice. For the taste, we think there were added sugar to enhance the taste. But good enough. They ask you beforehand if you want ice added or not. Stick to seasonal fruits & vegetables.

Experience: A very disinterested person took our order with short responses. It took about 3 to 5 min on a weekday for my order. Straws provided are sealed (+ point). They accept cash, paytm and cards.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjana Varma
featured_reviews.review_text: Pandy Cafe offers a cozy and welcoming ambiance, perfect for a relaxed hangout or casual meeting. Their menu features a delightful mix of coffees, desserts, and light snacks, all reasonably priced. The panda-themed decor adds a cute and unique charm to the place. Service is friendly and efficient, making the overall experience enjoyable. A great spot for coffee lovers and Instagram-worthy moments!

featured_reviews.name: Dhruv Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried out Pandey Ji’ cafe and it’s one of those budget-friendly spots that actually hits the spot 💯

From quick bites like sandwiches, wraps, and burgers to refreshing drinks & bubble tea — perfect for a chill snack break or late-night cravings. The best part? Pocket-friendly pricing + decent taste makes it a go-to for everyday hunger scenes.

It’s more of a grab-and-go place (no proper seating), but if you’re in the area and craving something quick & tasty, this one’s worth a try 👌

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Rajolkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Pandy Café offers a cozy atmosphere with charming panda-themed decor that’s perfect for a relaxed outing. The menu features a delightful mix of coffee, pastries, and light bites, all presented with cute, Instagram-worthy flair. Service is friendly and efficient, making it a great spot for casual meetups or solo coffee breaks.

featured_reviews.name: Shayan Zaidi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried their food and had a really great experience. The fries were perfectly cooked – crispy on the outside yet juicy and flavorful inside. The cheese balls were another highlight; they were rich, gooey, and absolutely delicious. I also tried their pizza combo, and it turned out to be the star of the meal. The pizza was fresh, well-topped, and full of flavor, making the combo a great value overall.

The portion sizes were satisfying, and the quality of ingredients was clearly noticeable. If you’re looking for a place that serves tasty snacks along with a fulfilling pizza option, this is definitely worth checking out. I would highly recommend trying their pizza combo along with the sides for a complete experience.

Thank you, Pandeyji Snacks, for the great service!

Note:☕ To have offer on coffee use Magicpin app or Third wave coffee app itself. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to Third Wave Coffee recently and it was a really good experience. They have a buy one get one free offer on Wednesdays, which is honestly a great deal and makes it worth planning a visit mid-week.

I tried the chocolate frappe and it was genuinely impressive. The texture was smooth and nicely thick, not icy or watered down like it sometimes is at other places. The chocolate flavor was rich without being too sweet, so it didn’t feel heavy even after a few sips.

What stood out the most was the quality. It just tasted better than what you usually get at bigger chains like Starbucks. It didn’t feel overly processed or rushed. There was more depth in the flavor, and you could tell a bit more care had gone into making it.

The place itself is also quite nice to sit in. It has a relaxed vibe, good for catching up with someone or just sitting with your drink for a while. Not too noisy, not too dull either.

Overall, really liked it. The Wednesday offer is a nice bonus, and the chocolate frappe alone makes it worth going back.

featured_reviews.name: Faaiq Faisal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Third Wave Coffee is a fantastic spot for anyone who truly appreciates a good cup of coffee. The ambiance is modern and inviting, making it perfect for both quick catch-ups and longer work sessions. Their menu offers a great variety, from classic brews to more experimental flavors, and the quality is consistently impressive.

What made my visit especially memorable was Priyanka, one of their baristas. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about coffee. She took the time to understand my preferences and recommended a drink that turned out to be absolutely perfect. You can tell she puts real care into every cup she prepares.

The service overall was smooth and efficient, even during a busy period, and the staff maintained a welcoming vibe throughout. Thanks to Priyanka’s excellent service and the café’s commitment to quality, Third Wave Coffee definitely stands out as a go-to place for coffee lovers.

featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Dudhat
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really great experience at Third Wave Coffee today! The service by Bhumika was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Also tried their banana - walnut cake and signature filter coffee and it was absolutely amazing — rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. Definitely one of the best café experiences I’ve had recently. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: DARSHAN MALAVIYA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sudama Snacks & Juices is a perfect place for variety lovers. Their pav bhaji is rich, buttery, and full of flavor with nicely toasted pav. The dosa is crispy and well-cooked, served with tasty chutney and sambhar. They also offer Chinese items which are quite good—noodles and fried rice are flavorful and satisfying.

Along with this, their fresh juices are refreshing and a must-try. Service is quick, prices are reasonable, and the place is great for a casual snack outing.

Overall, a nice spot for enjoying different cuisines at one place 👍

featured_reviews.name: Krunal Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointed with the juice served at Sudama Pure Veg. We ordered it for our child, expecting it to be fresh and of good quality, but it was not. The juice tasted diluted and did not seem fresh. What made the experience worse was that when we raised the issue and requested a replacement, the owner argued with us instead of addressing the complaint professionally and finding a solution. Good customer service is just as important as food quality, and unfortunately both were lacking during our visit. This was a disappointing experience and not worth the money. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and improves both quality control and customer service.

featured_reviews.name: Sushmita Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Sudama, a restaurant located just 10 minutes walking distance from Goregaon West Station, along with my sisters. I had fond memories of this place from 5-6 years ago, particularly for their Punjabi dishes. However, this visit left me with mixed feelings.
The menu seems to have shifted focus from serving traditional Punjabi dishes to offering mainly snacks and Chinese cuisine. Despite this, the quality of food remains impressive. We ordered Veg Crispy, Pizza, and Triple Fried Rice, and each dish was flavorful and well-prepared.
While the food was quite satisfying, the service left something to be desired. Although the staff was efficient, it felt like they were rushing us, almost like they wanted to finish quickly . This took away from what could have been a more relaxed dining experience.
Overall, Sudama is still a good choice if you’re looking for tasty food at a pocket-friendly price. Just be prepared for a slightly hurried pace of service.

featured_reviews.name: P S
featured_reviews.review_text: Dont order online food from here, I ordered it via zomato and although i understand it wasnt the restaurants fault,I reached out to zomato and they werent helpful so I did reached out to ask for help getting a resolution from the restaurant, if they could escalate the matter from their end with zomato, they were extremely dismissive and refused to help. I repeatedly explained how they aren't at fault but I just need help with escalation and they kept saying No, I dont understand if they do business with a 3rd party delivery service, how do they not have any means of communication with them?

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Kuwlekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered an paneer tikka wrap and the taste was okaish. The staff is not that experienced, I ordered multigrain wrap but they gave us spinach wrap. The price is on expensive side. Subway wrap is way better than this if we compare taste and price.

featured_reviews.name: Meghasree Basu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely horrible experience. I ordered a roll from here and the paper wrapping was completely stuck to the food. It was impossible to separate the wrap from the roll, and I literally ended up swallowing pieces of paper while eating.

This is not just poor food quality, it is a serious health and safety concern. Proper packaging is the bare minimum expected, especially when customers are paying close to ₹400 for a single item.

What made the experience worse was the customer service. When I called to report the issue, the female representative I spoke to was extremely poorly trained and clearly did not know how to speak to or handle customers facing a genuine food safety problem. There was no empathy, no accountability, and no effort to resolve the situation properly.

If this is the level of quality control and customer service being provided under Nature Bar, then honestly, God bless the restaurant. Extremely disappointing experience overall.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: The Nature Bar probably does more business via Zomato / Swiggy. We have ordered from here before but it’s a really nice place to eat in as well. The easiest landmark to find this place is the Royal Challenge restaurant located in the Yashodham area in Goregaon East. The Nature Bar is literally 5 to 6 paces away from the Royal Challenge restaurant. It’s a small place really with 2 proper tables that can seat 4 at each table and some high tables with stools. I think they can seat 10-12 people at the most. But I doubt it you will find it crowded- it’s more popular for ordering in online or takeout. The food is really yum, healthy and worth it. You should absolutely try the yellow bell pepper soup - it is bliss in a bowl. I don’t know of any other place that offers this soup. The menu has been crafted to help make healthy choices -vegetarian and non-vegetarian. Rice bowls, salads, wraps, sandwiches, soup, shakes - they got ‘em all. Staff is friendly too. I would prefer to eat in here any day over ordering as I feel the food they offer is best enjoyed straight from the kitchen and not in a plastic packaging that travels for 20-30 mins before it gets to you. Oh and by the way the Mexican rice bowl with quinoa is WOW… You should try it. This is definitely going to be my go to place for a meal that I can enjoy in peace and quiet rather than the noisy food court at the Oberoi mall nearby… Glad to have this place in the neighbourhood.

featured_reviews.name: Harshad Dhamankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited @cafenaturebar it's a beautiful place located at Goregaon East nearby Oberoi Mall offers well designed seating arrangement serves healthier food in terms of Vegetarian and Non-vegetarian dishes. You get more varieties to select from. Its a very good choice those who are looking for healthier meal option.
I had Spinach Avacado Smoothie which was so delicious not oversweet extra thick and definitely filling. In meal bowl I had cottage cheese with pesto sauce which contains brown rice as well.
Everything cooked from scratch and focus on freshest ingredients.
I met the owner Mrs Anu and she was very hospitable.
A perfect spot for those who are looking for healthier meal.

featured_reviews.name: Rupali Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: If you love pancakes, fruits, vegan, keto salads and meals, hit this cafe. They have an array of amazing dishes. They also serve infused water (cucumber and carrot).  We had pancake with fruits and nature bar paneer sandwich, mind both the food items were delicious and healthy. They served salad with sandwich which had moong, etc. For vegans it is a best place to have food. Also for weight watchers. Must visit.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Aggarwal
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the finest place to order food if you are focused on quality. They follow instructions to the T. The nature bar team also is super kind and customer focused by mistake they had sent a wrong order within no time they sent the right order to me. Customer service is par excellence...my favorite place to eat healthy food.

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri Umesh Borade
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the salad and fresh orange juice. This was most amazing food I had in recent times ... Goregaon is definitely progressing. Price was also fair.
